# XHub HD

> XHub HD is a high-density media directory providing free access to a large catalog of high-definition streaming video content.

This site is built as a fast, highly optimized portal allowing users to browse, search, and save videos locally without requiring user accounts or registration.

## Site Structure

- [Home](https://xvideoz.dpdns.org/): The main landing page featuring new releases, popular videos, and trending categories.
- [Catalog](https://xvideoz.dpdns.org/catalog): The complete, searchable video directory with infinite scrolling, pagination, and filtering options.
- [Favorites](https://xvideoz.dpdns.org/favorites): A local, browser-based library where users can save and revisit their preferred videos without requiring an account.
